The note is incorrect: Vincent J. Schaefer received U.S. Patent 2,527,238 for the "Weather Indicator and Cloud Expansion" (a cloud-seeding apparatus) in 1950, filed in 1948 and issued October 24, 1950. No 1947 patent for an "Electrical Indicator of Mechanical Expansion" was issued jointly to Schaefer and Langmuir.
